content: प्रयुक्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Yoked, harnessed. .²2 Used, employed (as a word <ab>&c.</ab>); सप्रयुक्तस्य दम्भस्य ब्रह्माप्यन्तं न गच्छति <ls>Pt. 1. 202</ls>. .²3 Applied. .²4 Appointed, nominated. .²5 Acted, represented. .²6 Arising or resulting from, produced by, consequent on; मेधाविनो नीतिगुणप्रयुक्तां पुरः स्फुरन्तीमिव दर्शयन्ति <ls>Pt. 1. 61</ls>. .²7 Endowed with. .²8 Lost in meditation, abstracted. .²9 Lent or put to interest (as money). .²10 Prompted, instigated, urged; गुणप्रयुक्ताः परमर्मभेदिनः <ls>Udb.</ls>; अथावमानेन प्रयुक्ता <ls>Ku. 1. 21</ls>. .²11 Directed, hurled at. .²12 Shaken, set in motion. .²13 Inflicted upon. .²14 Connected with. .²15 Thick, compact, closely united. .²16 Drawn (as a sword). .²17 Contrived. .²18 Suitable. .{@-क्तम्@} A cause.
